traces.question: The claim under test says the insoluble ZHSH by-product (Zn4SO4(OH)6·4H2O) is absent from Zn anodes cycled with NH4OAc, unlike the blank electrolyte. Does the XRD pattern in panel F3f support this?
traces.answer_key: No. The NH4OAc-cycled Zn pattern still carries a ZHSH marker: a weak peak at about 8.5 degrees remains, so the by-product is not fully absent (o12).
